plan: In a first-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically below my true value. Since my value is $14, I want to bid low enough to potentially win but not overpay. Given the $0-$49 range, other bidders might have high or low values. I'll bid around 70-80% of my true value to balance winning probability with profit margin. This means a bid around $10-$11 gives me room to potentially win while protecting my potential profit.
